verdict.rationale: Conductor lets developers skip API keys by signing in with existing subscriptions. Its pricing page says 'Bring your own subscriptions and keys', you can sign in to a Cursor subscription for cloud workspaces, and per-organization settings let Claude Code, Codex and Cursor use a subscription instead of an API key. However, these are third-party paid subscriptions, and nothing shows a free tier unlocked by a personal-account sign-in. Missing for 10: any evidence of free-tier access, a first-party personal-account sign-in that grants usage without a paid third-party subscription, and independent corroboration of the subscription sign-in flow.
